ops.body:
**Nov 25, `/tend inbox G14 yes`: a backup past one plain zip** (opened from `842dc419`; G14, "Backup: one zip past 65,535 files or 4 GiB, by a ZIP64 writer and reader of our own", the owner's yes in person, Nov 22, "Yes, queue it (Recommended)", decision 0256; built as `/slice backup-zip64 --from=G14`; an inbox run, so lenses 1-7 were not run).
- Built: BZ1-BZ7 (`specs/backup-zip64`), test first (7 of 7). `backup/zip.ts`, ours around fflate's `ZipPassThrough`, writes fflate's bytes within 65,535 entries and 4 GiB and ZIP64 past them (an 8-byte data descriptor, the extra field with only what overflows, ZIP64's end and locator), and reads a plain zip and a ZIP64 one alike. Past 65,535 entries the refusal is gone everywhere, past 4 GiB on a phone; the web, which holds the file in memory, keeps "This backup would be too large for one file, so it was not made." past 4 GiB (the owner in person to the steward's Silent 1-3, decision 0266, amending 0256). Read back past each limit by our reader, `unzip -t` (70,000 files) and Python's `zipfile` (4 GiB files, sparse on disk); within the limits an old/new differential against main's writer printed 0 bytes different (empty, seeded, odd refs, a waiting delete, exactly 65,535 entries; a moving clock, UTC and Chatham).
- The reviews: the steward on the plan, 7 accepted (backup-zip64 audit 1-7); the auditor on the diff, one round: 7 accepted, 6 fixed (audit 8 a leftover file swept before the room is read, the phone's io in `lib/export/index.native.ts`; 9 the reader's refusals; 11 a moving clock; 12 the web at 4,294,967,295 bytes; 13 the boundaries by Python and `unzip -t`; 14 the directory in one array) and audit 10 filed `[loop]` low (the web refusing before it writes needs its io to report sizes); keep-awake while making deferred `[owner]` medium; F8 rejected, noted for the device.
- Checks: `npm test` 3,975, typecheck, lint, `check:docs`, `check:records`; the journeys `backup` (18 ok, its checks the same before and after) and `launch` (stopped once at the Layers click under "Past the sights", green on its rerun; on `main` it failed 1 of 3 by `e2e:baseline`, at another step). The weekly full pass, due since 2026-11-23, was not run: the coordinator's instruction for this build is the journeys its fixes touch.
- Filed: no entry. `docs/DEFERRED.md`, Back up everything: keep-awake `[owner]`, the web's refusal before writing `[loop]` low, "Last backup made" after a target that cannot take 4 GiB `[loop]` low, the web's memory item widened. `docs/NATIVE_UNVERIFIED.md`, Media and capture: four items (a phone's write past 4 GiB and 65,535 files; Archive Utility, Explorer and a streaming reader; a full disk and a killed run; 20 GB with the screen locking and each share target).
- Waiting with the owner's yes, for the next `/tend inbox`: G5, G7, G8, G12; G9 also waits on the walk drawer sections slice reaching main.
- The balance: outgrowing its base (six of the eight areas swept twice or more are rough); no new G filed.
- Nothing here has run on a phone.
